name: Harmony in Balance
summary: On Zephras Isle, Rorian the Dayseeker gives fledgling adventurers an early rite of duty. You thin the vuldren in Thendal Grove to protect the island’s natural balance, for its beasts feel magic shifting in the winds.

sections.title: Tending the Grove
sections.body: In Thendal Grove, vuldren have grown too numerous for the island to sustain. Their numbers threaten the environmental harmony that supports Zephras Isle’s wildlife. Rorian the Dayseeker gives young protectors the duty of thinning the herd before it strains the grove and the life around it.

sections.title: Winds of Unrest
sections.body: Vuldren are usually docile, yet the beasts of Zephras Isle are sensitive to the island’s atmosphere. When magic carried on the winds falls out of balance, they respond sharply. Keeping their numbers in check helps prevent them from becoming unpredictable and dangerous pests.

faq.q: Why do the vuldren need to be culled?
faq.answer: The vuldren population in Thendal Grove has surged beyond sustainable numbers. Left unchecked, they could exhaust local resources and upset the balance that sustains the grove’s other inhabitants.
Rorian the Dayseeker is an elder guide and mentor on Zephras Isle. He oversees young adventurers’ training and teaches them to care for their home through great crises and everyday stewardship.

faq.q: What makes the vuldren act up?
faq.answer: Vuldren are usually docile, but Zephras Isle’s native beasts sense when magic in the island’s winds falls out of balance. That shift can change their behavior.

faq.q: Where does this task take place?
faq.answer: You carry out the work in Thendal Grove, just east and southeast of the settlement on Zephras Isle.

faq.q: What lesson is Rorian trying to teach?
faq.answer: Rorian teaches that protecting your home can demand difficult measures. A guardian sometimes has to take a firm guiding hand to restore natural order.

faq.q: What should be done while hunting the vuldren?
faq.answer: Nearby, Elatrell Featherlight asks you to look into a swarm of pesky cirrusflies. You can investigate the infestation in the grove while hunting vuldren.

angles.text: As a druid, you know that thinning an overgrown vuldren population can protect the wider ecosystem.
As a hunter, you learn to manage herd numbers and watch how native beasts respond to changes around them.
